---
title: "14. Coastal Observatories"
---

Coastal community observatories enable community members to conduct year-round continuous monitoring of their local ocean environments, collecting valuable baseline and time-series data for tracking the changing ocean conditions.

ONC collaborates with community partners to custom-design each observatory to meet local needs.
This partnership recognises the value of place-based knowledge and pairs it with oceanographic instruments, high-tech design, training, and scientific support. 
The observatory data can be used by researchers, community members, Indigenous leaders, governments and others to inform decision-making for a sustainable ocean future.

---

## Coastal Observatory hydrophone data use cases

*Click a marker to see how many hydrophone use cases each observatory has, by category.*

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

import html
import pandas as pd
import folium

# 1. Coordinate lookup dictionary (renamed keys to 'lat' and 'lon')
coords = {
    "Cambridge Bay":    {"lat": 69.1125, "lon": -105.0632},
    "Campbell River":   {"lat": 49.8450, "lon": -125.0059},
    "China Creek":      {"lat": 49.1534, "lon": -124.7936},
    "Digby Island":     {"lat": 54.2588, "lon": -130.4307},
    "Hartley Bay":      {"lat": 53.4225, "lon": -129.2475},
    "Kitamaat Village": {"lat": 53.9800, "lon": -128.6500},
    "Burrard Inlet":    {"lat": 49.2982, "lon": -123.0033}
}

# Popup categories: label, colour, and a small line icon.
categories = {
    "Published paper": {
        "one": "Published paper",
        "many": "Published papers",
        "color": "#3468a8",
        "icon": "books",
    },
    "Education & outreach": {
        "one": "Outreach",
        "many": "Outreach",
        "color": "#e06a32",
        "icon": "people",
    },
    "PhD/ Masters thesis": {
        "one": "Masters/PhD thesis",
        "many": "Masters/PhD theses",
        "color": "#7b4ea3",
        "icon": "cap",
    },
    "Student research": {
        "one": "Student research",
        "many": "Student research",
        "color": "#c4893a",
        "icon": "pencil",
    },
    "Environmental monitoring": {
        "one": "Environmental monitoring",
        "many": "Environmental monitoring",
        "color": "#3c9a5c",
        "icon": "leaf",
    },
    "Environmental management": {
        "one": "Environmental management",
        "many": "Environmental management",
        "color": "#3a8494",
        "icon": "clipboard",
    },
    "Industry & technology applications": {
        "one": "Industry & technology application",
        "many": "Industry & technology applications",
        "color": "#5c6bc0",
        "icon": "factory",
    },
}

icons = {
    "books": '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M4 19.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 17H20"/><path d="M6.5 2H20v20H6.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 4 19.5v-15A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 2z"/></svg>',
    "people": '<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="#fff"><circle cx="4.2" cy="9" r="1.7"/><path d="M1.1 17.8c.25-2.3 1.45-3.7 3.1-3.7s2.85 1.4 3.1 3.7H1.1z"/><circle cx="19.8" cy="9" r="1.7"/><path d="M16.7 17.8c.25-2.3 1.45-3.7 3.1-3.7s2.85 1.4 3.1 3.7h-6.2z"/><circle cx="12" cy="7.2" r="2.15"/><path d="M8 18.5c.45-2.9 1.95-4.6 4-4.6s3.55 1.7 4 4.6H8z"/></svg>',
    "cap": '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M2 9l10-5 10 5-10 5L2 9z"/><path d="M6 11.5V16c0 1.4 2.7 2.8 6 2.8s6-1.4 6-2.8v-4.5"/></svg>',
    "pencil": '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.1 2.1 0 0 1 3 3L8 18l-4 1 1-4z"/></svg>',
    "leaf": '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 19c8 0 14-8 14-14-6 0-14 6-14 14z"/><path d="M9 15c2-2.5 4.5-4.2 7-5"/></svg>',
    "clipboard": '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="6" y="4" width="12" height="16" rx="2"/><path d="M9 4h6v2.2H9z"/><path d="M9 12h6M9 16h4"/></svg>',
    "factory": '<svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M3 21V10l5 3V10l5 3V8h8v13z"/><path d="M3 21h18"/></svg>',
}

pin = '<svg width="13" height="13" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path fill="#e15b4a" d="M12 22s7-7.2 7-12a7 7 0 1 0-14 0c0 4.8 7 12 7 12z"/><circle cx="12" cy="10" r="2.3" fill="#fff"/></svg>'

# 2. Read Excel sheet & clean up
df = pd.read_excel('../docs/Coastal Observatory hydrophone use cases.xlsx')
df = df.rename(columns={'CCO': 'location'})

if 'Sensor type' in df.columns:
    df = df[df['Sensor type'].str.contains('Hydrophone', case=False, na=False)]

# In-progress studies stay off the map to protect privacy.
df = df[df['Use case category'] != 'In progress study']
df = df.dropna(subset=['location', 'Use case category'])

# Map coordinates
df['lat'] = df['location'].map(lambda x: coords.get(x, {}).get('lat'))
df['lon'] = df['location'].map(lambda x: coords.get(x, {}).get('lon'))
df = df.dropna(subset=['lat', 'lon'])

# 3. Initialize Map
m = folium.Map(
    location=[62.0, -110.0],
    zoom_start=4,
    tiles="https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png",
    attr="&copy; <a href='https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright'>OpenStreetMap</a> contributors &copy; <a href='https://carto.com/attributions'>CARTO</a>"
)

m.get_root().html.add_child(folium.Element("""
<style>
.leaflet-popup-content-wrapper {
  position: relative;
  border-radius: 16px;
  padding: 8px 2px 10px;
  box-shadow: none;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 18px rgba(16, 32, 51, 0.16));
  overflow: visible;
}
.leaflet-popup-content-wrapper::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  bottom: -9px;
  margin-left: -11px;
  border-width: 11px 11px 0;
  border-style: solid;
  border-color: #fff transparent transparent transparent;
}
.leaflet-popup-content { margin: 14px 16px 12px; }
.leaflet-popup-tip-container { display: none; }
</style>
"""))

def category_card(category, count):
    meta = categories.get(category)
    if meta is None:
        label = category
        color = "#5c6b7a"
        icon = ""
    else:
        label = meta["one"] if count == 1 else meta["many"]
        color = meta["color"]
        icon = icons[meta["icon"]]
    return (
        '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:8px 10px;'
        f'border:1px solid {color};border-radius:12px;background:#fff;">'
        f'<span style="flex:none;width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:{color};'
        'display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;">'
        f'{icon}</span>'
        '<span style="font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.25;color:#1b2430;">'
        f'<span style="font-weight:800;">{count}</span> {html.escape(label)}</span></div>'
    )

# 4. One marker per observatory, with a count for each category
grouped = df.groupby(['location', 'lat', 'lon'])

for (loc_name, lat, lon), group in grouped:
    counts = group.groupby('Use case category')['Use case ID'].nunique()
    ordered = [cat for cat in categories if counts.get(cat, 0)]
    ordered += [cat for cat in counts.index if cat not in categories and counts.get(cat, 0)]
    if not ordered:
        continue

    total = int(sum(int(counts[cat]) for cat in ordered))
    cards = "".join(category_card(cat, int(counts[cat])) for cat in ordered)
    use_cases = "use case" if total == 1 else "use cases"

    popup_content = (
        '<div style="font-family:system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;width:236px;color:#1b2430;">'
        '<div style="display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px;margin:0 10px 11px 0;">'
        f'<span style="margin-top:3px;line-height:0;">{pin}</span>'
        '<div>'
        f'<div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:-0.01em;line-height:1.2;">{html.escape(loc_name)}</div>'
        f'<div style="margin-top:2px;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:#8b93a0;">{total} {use_cases}</div>'
        '</div></div>'
        f'<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;">{cards}</div>'
        '</div>'
    )

    folium.Marker(
        location=[lat, lon],
        popup=folium.Popup(popup_content, max_width=280),
        icon=folium.Icon(color="blue", icon="info-sign")
    ).add_to(m)

m
```
